scripts.build: CI=true pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false sh -c 'node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs run typecheck && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @workspace/app run build && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs --filter @workspace/api-server run build'
scripts.build:all: node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs run typecheck && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs run typecheck:libs && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
